trans-unit.source: Manage indexers, run previews, and review recent indexing activity.
Configure core credentials and Qdrant settings here. Values stored here override TypoScript and stay hidden after save.
External source connections are managed in the Connectors tab.
Health check and system overview are available under Diagnostics.
Enter Qdrant host URL, e.g. http://qdrant:6333
Sensitive value: input is not displayed after saving.
Input is too long. Maximum allowed: %s characters.
Review which TYPO3 sites expose an AI chat profile, which collection they use, and whether their setup is unique and language-aware.
Review the currently active chat behavior for frontend conversations.
Use the current site language and fall back to default-language content when needed.
Hide direct contact details unless the user explicitly asks for contact, responsibility, phone, or email.
These sites are marked as chat-enabled but do not define `aiAssistant.collection`:
These collections are used by multiple sites. This weakens tenant separation:
These enabled sites still use the default fallback because no main profile exists yet:
These sites already have a main profile but still keep additional site prompt overrides. Check whether those rules should move into the main profile.
These sites already route prompts cleanly through their main profile without additional site prompt overrides.
Indexer records define how files, pages, and external content are indexed.

Each row represents one effective index scope: type, site scope, and target collection. The indexer record controls what gets chunked and indexed for that scope. Indexers can only be deleted after their indexed data has been purged.
Only sites with `aiAssistant.collection` in Site Configuration can be selected for indexers.
External indexers show their current Shopware time window here: either cursor-based after a successful run or lookback-based before the first successful run.

Legend: Window: cursor = incremental mode using the last stored Shopware cursor. Window: lookback Nd = fallback mode using connector lookback_days, otherwise global shopware.indexing.lookbackDays. Configure the connector in Settings > Connectors.
Optional run parameters for this indexer.
Optional run parameters for this file indexer. Dry-run writes nothing to Qdrant. Only changed limits the run to updated or new files.
Optional run parameters for this page indexer. Dry-run writes nothing to Qdrant. Only changed limits the run to updated or new pages.
Optional run parameters for this external indexer. Leave Since empty to use the normal cursor/lookback logic.
Opens run options for this indexer.
Run as dry-run without writing to Qdrant
Example: 2026-01-01 or 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00. Leave empty to use the normal cursor/lookback logic.
Optional override for the target Qdrant collection. Known configured collections are listed here.
Maximum number of Shopware products to process in this run. Allowed range: 1 to 500.
Maximum number of sources to inspect for this run. Leave the default if you want the normal backend limit.
Restrict this run to updated or new sources only.
Enables this indexer again for manual runs and cronjobs.
Disables this indexer for manual runs and cronjobs without deleting its configuration.
This indexer is disabled. Enable it first to start a run.
Deletes the indexer record after all indexed data for this scope has been removed.
Purge this scope's indexed data from Qdrant and local source tracking before deleting the indexer.
Delete indexed content for this scope from Qdrant and local source tracking?
No TYPO3 site with `aiAssistant.collection` is configured. Add this to Site Configuration before creating indexers.

This view shows the indexed content currently stored for each effective index scope. Each row represents one effective index scope: indexer type, site scope, and target collection. Purge removes only that scope's stored data from Qdrant and local source tracking. It does not delete the indexer record itself.
No indexed data scopes available yet.
Shows AI Chat error entries from the last two weeks. Expand an entry to inspect the raw log payload and stack trace.
No recent ai_assistant errors found in the log file.
No AI Chat errors in the last %s days.
Connectors define how external content is fetched. External indexers reference one connector and write the indexed data into their site-specific collection.
Each site can define a dedicated main profile for the default chatbot.
Create additional sub-profiles only when a specific chat element should use a narrower scope or a different assistant identity.
Leave the profile field empty in a chat element to use the site's main profile or the default chatbot configuration.
Multiple active main profiles exist for the same site. The first one wins as fallback, so this should be cleaned up.
This sub-bot profile is still used by chat content elements and cannot be deleted.
Inspect persisted developer traces for chat routing, retrieval, prompts, and responses.
The chat dev log is currently disabled. Enable it in TypoScript to inspect chat traces in this module.
Enable this only in development environments. Chat traces may contain user input and derived response data.
The dev log is enabled outside development mode. Review this carefully from a privacy perspective.

Conversation id for grouping chat events. Example: tt-17-assistant-0 means tt_content uid 17 with no explicitly selected sub-profile. tt-17-assistant-5 means the same chat element with sub-profile uid 5.
No chat traces have been recorded yet.
